title: A system overview for near-term, low-trust AI compute verification
author: Naci Cankaya
description: A working draft proposing a privacy-preserving, retrofittable architecture for verifying AI compute under an arms-control-style agreement between rival states. It separates evidence capture (network taps) from evaluation in secure audit environments, so compliance can be checked without mutually trusted silicon or exposing confidential data.
